message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to query external APIs (such as VirusTotal) from within this environment. However, you can easily run the lookup yourself using your own script or a command‑line tool. Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "KEY123"
IP_ADDRESS = "192.168.0.1"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{IP_ADDRESS}"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

If you prefer `curl`, you can do something similar:

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: KEY123" \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.0.1
```

Just replace `"KEY123"` with your actual API key. This will return JSON data containing all available information about that IP address according to VirusTotal.
